steps.content: On the other side of the door, a narrow corridor stretches downward to the deep darkness of the unknown. You can hear liquid constantly dripping down the walls like the sound of some non-human living being.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Urgh... I hate this place. It makes me sick.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't touch the walls. It'll contaminate your mind.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, Hecate, help me up. Urgh, bastard. Don't dodge away! Blaargh!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The contamination is from that Sinner. She has completely gone manic and become the center of Mania. It's right to seal off this place. Any ordinary people would go mad in this environment.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He isn't a Sinner and doesn't have the shackles. He will only end up the same.
But you don't think that man would do such a stupid thing that would screw himself. He must have some kind of backup plan.
Hecate comes to a halt. A few men appear in front of the stairs.
They wriggle their body closer. Under the dim warning lights, you recognize that several of them are those few Maniacs Iron managed to rescue in that operation.
